LanguageData.SCP_035PossessionBody: {PAWN} put on SCP-035. The mask has seized control, and the host's body is decomposing.
LanguageData.SCP_035RecoveredBody: The mask has reached your colony. Secure it immediately and prevent prolonged visual contact.
LanguageData.SCP_035QuestUnavailable: The SCP-035 recovery quest is currently unavailable.
LanguageData.SCP_035QuestOffered: The SCP-035 recovery quest has been offered.
LanguageData.SCP_035ObservedReport: The porcelain mask gives observers a persistent urge to wear it. Visual contact must be limited.
LanguageData.SCP_035PartialReport: Prolonged observation makes the urge irresistible. A wearer loses control and their tissues begin to decay.
LanguageData.SCP_035DocumentedReport: Five cumulative hours of visual contact compel a pawn to put on the mask. The host dies after roughly two hours of decay.
